logp.method_description: A freshly prepared stock solution of complexes 1–3 in DMSO/H2O (2:1) was added to 600 μL of water. A 100 uL of this solution was taken out and diluted to 5 mL using double deionized water, and the amount of Re was quantified using ICP-MS. To the 500 μL of the remaining aqueous solution, 500 μL of octanol was added. The biphasic mixture was shaken for 2 h using an orbital shaker. The mixture was then allowed to settle down for effective phase separation, and the aqueous and organic layers were carefully separated. 100 μL of the aqueous layer was carefully taken out and diluted to 5 mL using double deionized water for quantification of Re using ICP-MS. Log P was then calculated by the following formula log P = log((C0 - C2) / C2). where C0 = initial concentration of Re in ppb (preshaking) and C2 = concentration of the metal in ppb after 2 h (postshaking).
